description: This file declares the interface for managing TLS contexts and operations within the VQUIC component for curl, supporting multiple TLS backends like OpenSSL, GnuTLS, and WolfSSL. It includes function prototypes for initialization, cleanup, verification, and callback handling related to QUIC TLS connections.

methods.name: Curl_vquic_tls_init
methods.description: Initializes QUIC TLS contexts based on the connection and peer configurations, supporting optional early setup callback.

methods.name: Curl_vquic_tls_cleanup
methods.description: Cleans up all TLS context data that was previously initialized.

methods.name: Curl_vquic_tls_before_recv
methods.description: Performs any required operations before receiving data over the TLS connection.

methods.name: Curl_vquic_tls_verify_peer
methods.description: Verifies the peer certificate after the handshake, ensuring requirements are fulfilled.

ctags.name: Curl_vquic_tls_ctx_setup
